title: Finale Mortar Rack — Bill of Materials
per_unit: One rack (5 rows × 5 tubes = 25 tubes). Build 2 identical racks for the full finale.
material: 1/2 in. plywood (walls) + hardwood dowel rod (top retention)

standard_stock.name: 4×8 sheet (1/2 in. plywood)
standard_stock.notes: Brown + green + blue walls for both racks on one sheet (~12 sq ft of parts)

standard_stock.name: 2 in. dowel rod
standard_stock.notes: ≥6 ft; four cuts × 17-7/8 in. (middle dowels, both racks)

standard_stock.name: 1-1/2 in. dowel rod
standard_stock.notes: ≥6 ft; four cuts × 17-7/8 in. (inner dowels, both racks)

parts.name: End wall (front & back)
parts.notes: row-board-bottom.scad — top-half lap at six column X.

parts.name: Green divider (+X)
parts.notes: column-board-bottom.scad — bottom lap at brown; upper lap at blue mid rows.

parts.name: Mid row divider (between tube rows)
parts.notes: row-board-middle.scad — bottom edge z = 1-3/4 in.; bottom-half lap at columns.

parts.name: Mortar tube (HDPE)
parts.notes: 2-3/8 in. OD × 12 in.; tilt per row angle when loaded.

building_two_racks.overview: Cut and notch all plywood for both racks in one session, then assemble two identical frames. Load 25 tubes per rack on site.
steps: Print or open this BOM and preview rack.scad in OpenSCAD.
From one 4×8 sheet, cut 4 brown, 12 green, and 8 blue blanks (sizes in parts table).
Notch all green columns, then brown ends, then blue mid rows (see README half-lap table).
Cut dowels: 4× 2 in. OD and 4× 1.5 in. OD, each 17-7/8 in. long.
Assemble rack A: columns → blue mid rows → brown ends → fasten → insert dowels → 25 tubes.
Repeat for rack B. Label A/B if fuse wiring differs.
Transport racks separately; place side by side on field; wire shells 47–96.

cut_layout.plywood_sheet: One 4×8 — all plywood walls for 2 racks
cut_layout.dowel_stock: One 6 ft (or longer) stick each of 2 in. and 1-1/2 in. dowel
tips: Each rack is 5×5 (25 tubes); build two racks for the 50-tube Commander finale.
Green boards are 17-7/8 in. long (depth); brown and blue span 23-3/8 in. (width).
Middle dowels (2 in.) at ±6 in. X; inner dowels (1.5 in.) at ±2 in. X.
Label racks A/B before loading tubes if shell-to-position mapping differs.
OpenSCAD models one rack; double every cut qty for two racks.
